notes.title: Cast VR - Full release
notes.content:
[b]Version: 1.1.0[/b]

As much as we want to keep improving the game, we cannot keep it in early access forever. [b]Cast VR has left early access![/b] The game can now be experienced as a complete project. We are not done with Cast yet and will be uploading small improvements and fixes as we make them. It has been a long road and a lot of effort to get the game into a new state. We have updated huge parts of the game and refined a lot. The game is still far from perfect but we are finally happy with how the new spell system feels and we are really excited about having everyone experience it for themselves. 

[b]Major Updates:[/b]

[u]Spell Recast System[/u]
Wanting to make the gameplay a lot smoother we have a new spell system. This system allows you to select spells more easily and recast them even easier. Select your spell from a wheel, aim, fire and then wave your wand enough to cast it again.

[u]New Spell Book[/u]
The spell book has had a complete makeover, instead of needing it to cast spells, you use it for what books are best for: Looking up information. The new book allows you to go over what your current objective is, or read more on how a spell works. Not only that but you can now edit your settings mid game.

[u]VFX Updates[/u]
Along with our new spell system we have redone Most VFX in the game. Have a look out for the new flashy sparkles and pops that you can throw around. Finding spell books should be a lot more clear as they now float and glow at you instead of being… well books.

[u]A New Enemy[/u]
The knights were looking a little tough for the first thing you fight, so we have added a new enemy to the mix, wisps that are spawned out of magic in the air. Keep an eye out when exploring the castle.

[u]Puzzles Re-Tweaked[/u]
A couple puzzles that particularly confused people have been edited to give players a lot more information to work with. This with the book should make some parts of the game a lot more clear if you miss a dialogue line or two. Making a few others feel a little more polished.

[u]Lighting Fixes[/u]
A couple of rooms has some lighting mishaps, each room should be up to date and looking better than ever.

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
We have addressed a lot of bugs
Fixed being able to teleport into some walls
Fixed many Knight animation bugs
Fixed edge case crashes
Fixed a softlock
Reintroduced a softlock
Refixed a softlock
Fixed the incorrect dialogue being played at certain times
Many many more

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 1.0.5
notes.content:
Patch Notes: Build 1.0.5
15/06/2020

[list]
VFX Fixes:
[*] Updated one of the puppet's projectile VFX
[*] Make sure the immortal knight un-cracks when reviving.

AI Fixes & Tweaks:
[*] Fixed an issue where one of the puppets could get stuck and no longer dash
[*] Update AI navigation to fix some AI going where they should not be able to go and vice-versa.

General Fixes:
[*] Various audio fixes (sounds not playing when they should)
[*] Fixed issue where player could avoid damage by using spellbook
[*] Disabled ability to rotate while using vamos. Vamos uses the right-hand joystick to move an object around and rotating uses the same joystick. So we disabled rotation to avoid errors
[*] Fixed animation issues related to timescale. Now, even if time is slowed down, the dialogue animation does not go out of sync
[*] Difficulty balance tweaks
[*] You can now physically interact with objects with your wand
[*] Puzzle Fixes (Damna & Segos upgrade puzzles)
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KEHVfcj8qSc;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]We have decided to make community participation official by making Cast VR [u]Early Access[/u].[/b]

We’re excited to see people playing our game and really grateful for everyone's feedback.

[b]At present, what we are working on:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lots of small bits of feedback that can be acted on quickly
[*]Crashes experienced with particular headsets
[*]Make is easier to remind yourself what each spell does
[*]Make it easier to know what your current objective is
[*]Make spell book less clunky
[/list]

[b]Crashes[/b]
We are aware some people are experiencing crashes - which we hadn’t experienced in testing and found very hard to replicate and therefore solve. As gamers ourselves, we know that can be frustrating when the game doesn’t work the way it’s meant to be experienced.  [u]Fixing these crashes is our first priority.[/u]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Build 1.0.3
notes.content:
27/04/2020
[list]
[*] Fixed memory leak & related crashes
[*] Improved stability
[*] Upgraded FMOD integration
[*] Audio fixes
[*] Gameplay & misc fixes
[/list]
[list]
[*]We’ve plugged the leak! A small issue in coding which was causing the game to increase the memory being used as the game was played has been fixed. This should also help stop any related game crashes.
We have also improved the stability of the game! Less crashes = more time to be casting spells!
We have upgraded FMOD integration with the game...I guess you could say that they’re kinda like a clock and their cogs are meshing together now.
[*]Was that white noise really bothering you? Well worry no more! We have fixed some of the audio issues you guys let us know about. That should be some music to your ears.
We have also thrown in some gameplay and miscellaneous fixes to improve the feel and quality of the game. 
[/list]
